Contract:
Each `specs///.spec.md`. Every top-level `##` section wrapped with `…` (open before header, close before next same-level header or EOF). Sub-sections and entity-level headers are NOT wrapped — they live inside the containing anchor. Section names are author-discretionary; the template below shows idiomatic choices. Grammar source of truth: the `sdd-extract` CLI (`gennady sdd-extract `, name grammar `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*$`). DbC subsection shape is flexible per `AX_PORTS_AND_ABSTRACTIONS_DISCIPLINE`.
Section order is general → specific (arc42 / C4): orientation (what it is, its shape, how it is used) → context & map (where it sits, what is inside) → contract detail (folded) → physical layout & decisions → handoff & appendix. Heavy reference detail folds under `` per `AX_SPEC_PROGRESSIVE_DISCLOSURE` so the reader sees the shape without wading through every precondition.
